scope: Compact export of recorded measurements; detailed arrays removed, not a new experiment.

measurement.dataset: CSE-CIC-IDS2018 official processed daily flow CSVs

protocol.scope: temporal drift/adaptation only; no AutoML optimization on CSE
protocol.target: binary: Benign vs any non-Benign label
protocol.model: LightGBM 100 estimators, learning_rate=0.05, num_leaves=31, CPU n_jobs=1
protocol.adaptation_window: initial labeled training sample plus most recent 3 labeled replay chunks
limitations: Daily CSV source order is not chronological; timestamps are parsed day-first and sorted before replay.
This is a binary attack/benign replay over a CIC testbed schedule, not a production network stream.
Label-based error detection assumes labels arrive at chunk end and is not an unlabeled early-warning detector.

environment.chronological_sort: DuckDB ORDER BY parsed timestamp; disk-backed for the large capture

run_audit.exclusion_reconciliation: 59 repeated CSV header rows + 14 out-of-capture-day timestamps = 73 unique rows; five out-of-day rows occur in the initial capture and 68 exclusions occur in replay captures.
run_audit.update_timing_note: One labeled-error refit measured 804.64 s at stream chunk 392 (2018-02-20); median was 4.82 s and p95 7.76 s. The cause of this isolated wall-time outlier is not established. Aggregate refit wall time is not a clean compute-budget estimate and must be remeasured under stable, isolated conditions.
run_audit.project_workload: MOPSO and other CPU research runs overlapped part of this replay; one label-error update measured 804.64 s. Treat wall-clock update totals as exploratory.
